county_election_office.name: Maury County Election Commission, 1207A Tradewinds Drive, Columbia
county_election_office.hours: Office open Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM: 1207A Tradewinds Drive, Columbia. Questions by email go to its help desk, support@mauryelections.happyfox.com.

zip_caveats: A ZIP doesn't tell us your districts here. Maury County is split between two U.S. House districts (5 and 9, redrawn in May 2026) and two state House districts (64 and 71), and the lines run through Columbia. Your districts are on your sample ballot in GoVoteTN or in the state's district lookup. The mayor and vice mayor races are only for voters who live inside Columbia city limits; a Columbia mailing address isn't enough. Some 38401 addresses are inside Mount Pleasant: if you live in Mount Pleasant, choose Mount Pleasant from the list of places. Small edges of 38401 reach into Marshall and Williamson counties, and the other county's ballot has different races. If your voter card names another county, this is not your ballot.

early_in_person.hours_note: Maury County: Wednesday, October 14 through Thursday, October 29, at the Election Commission office, 1207 Tradewinds Drive, Columbia. Monday to Friday 8 AM to 4 PM; Saturdays 8 AM to noon; closed Sundays. A second site in Spring Hill was open October 22 to 24 only. The last day, Thursday, October 29, runs 8 AM to 4 PM.
early_in_person.hours_short: Last day Thursday, October 29: the Election Commission office, 1207 Tradewinds Drive, Columbia, 8 AM to 4 PM.

situations.short: The request deadline passed Oct 24, so vote early today until 4 PM or at your polling place Nov 3.
situations.answer: The deadline to ask for an absentee ballot was Saturday, October 24. If yours hasn't come, call the Maury County Election Commission at 931-375-6001. Today, Thursday, October 29, is the last day of early voting: the Election Commission office, 1207 Tradewinds Drive, Columbia, 8 AM to 4 PM. On Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, vote at your own polling place before 7 PM.
steps: Call the Election Commission, 931-375-6001 (Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM), and ask how to vote in person instead.
See whether your ballot was sent or received: the state's Voter Registration Lookup at tnmap.tn.gov/voterlookup.
Already filled it in? Mail it so it arrives by 7 PM on November 3. Tennessee doesn't let you hand it in at a polling place or the office.

situations.short: On Nov 3, vote at your assigned precinct; the county's Where do I vote page shows how to find it.
situations.answer: On Election Day, Maury County voters must vote at their assigned precinct; at any other one, you'll be sent to yours. The county's Where do I vote page says how to find it: GoVoteTN gives your precinct code (like 2-1), and the county's table on that page gives its polling place. Or call 931-375-6001.
steps: Moved within Maury County and didn't update your address? You can still vote on Election Day: you'll sign an affidavit to update it first.
At the wrong place? Ask the poll officials for your right one, and go there before 7 PM.
